title: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting decision (MPM Dec 17-18)
source: NEWS: boj.or.jp 'Monetary Policy Meetings' schedule page (en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/), fetched raw (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and column-parsed out of the HTML table direct 2026-09-05. The table's columns are 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', and the December 2026 row reads 'Dec. 17 (Thurs.), 18 (Fri.)' with '-' in the Outlook column, 'Dec. 28 (Mon.)' for the Summary of Opinions and 'Jan. 27 (Wed.), 2027' for the Minutes; the decision publishes at the meeting's conclusion on the second day. NOT an Outlook Report meeting, unlike October. Filed estimate on two counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for any other central bank, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Understating the label only widens caution.
notes: Proposed during the boj-decision-2026-10-30 initial research (2026-09-05) as the next venue after that decision, and the meeting the surveyed consensus most often names for a further hike if October holds. Reuters' Aug 17-24 2026 poll (published 2026-08-26, 58 economists, press-cited) found 'a minority, 10 of 58, expected it to follow with another hike to 1.5% in either October or December' — this is the December half of that ~17%. SAME CHANNEL, SAME CAVEAT AS THE SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER ENTRIES: a BoJ move propagates to this calendar's long-duration AI names through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledger; symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed. Policy rate is 1.0% as of the 2026-07-31 statement (8-1, Takata dissenting for 1.25%) — see boj-decision-2026-09-18.json for the primary citation. IMPACT IS MEDIUM for the same reason as the sibling BoJ entries. The decision announcement lands overnight ET and reaches the US tape as a 12-18 open. Date is the JST decision date, matching how the BoJ publishes it. THE PLACEMENT WARNING CARRIES OVER FROM SEPTEMBER, NOT OCTOBER: 12-18 is quarterly opex (see opex-2026-12-18.json), so this decision hits the US tape in the same thirty minutes as a triple-witching SET settlement — the exact confound the boj-decision-2026-09-18 ledger banked its attribution discipline for. Adjacent on this calendar: ecb-decision-2026-12-17 the day before and opex-2026-12-18 the same session.
